ambiguities.text: The fraction of data a node must download 'approximately 1/8' could decrease to '1/16 or 1/32' through parameter adjustments
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume current mainnet parameters require 1/8 custody. Security analysis should consider that reduced custody fractions may have different security properties.

ambiguities.text: The term 'pseudorandomized sampling' is used without specifying the exact randomization algorithm
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume cryptographically secure pseudorandom function based on node ID and slot number. Actual algorithm defined in consensus-specs.

ambiguities.text: No explicit timeout or retry policy specified for column sampling requests
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume implementation-specific timeouts with retry logic. Security analysis should consider timeout-based DoS vectors.

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot control more than a significant fraction of nodes to perform a data withholding attack (probabilities assume honest majority)
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: With sufficient node control, attacker could successfully convince nodes that data is available when it is not, potentially allowing invalid state transitions

implicit_assumptions.description: Node IDs used for custody assignment are not easily manipulable by attackers
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Attacker could generate node IDs to concentrate custody of specific columns, enabling targeted data withholding

implicit_assumptions.description: The network has sufficient honest nodes (>10,000 referenced) with diverse peer connections
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Security probability bounds assume large network; smaller networks have weaker security guarantees

implicit_assumptions.description: Erasure coding reconstruction requires 50% of columns, which is a fundamental cryptographic property that cannot be circumvented
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: If reconstruction threshold could be reduced below 50%, security model would need recalculation
